lanes.reason: Totals first; rounding waits on the owner's answer about half-cent currencies, and the statement waits on rounding, so nothing else can start until then.

rulings.decision: Tiled panes and cards share one 12-point gutter across the Mac, the iPhone, the iPad and Android, including the long-title and right-to-left cases the owner raised on the 3rd, so that no surface invents its own spacing again.
rulings.reversal: One constant, and the captures retaken Revisit if a surface ships a layout the shared rule can't express, then say which surface and why.
